verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Trigger.dev serves an llms.txt at trigger.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and an llms-full.txt also exists. Docs pages are published as .md, and first-party agent-oriented material is documented: a 'Building with AI' guide and Skills, which are portable instruction sets for AI coding assistants. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and a root docs.md, which returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Tasks are plain async/await functions with no workflow DSL, no determinism rules, and no execution time limit.
Skills are portable instruction sets that teach AI coding assistants how to use Trigger.dev effectively.
Give your AI assistant direct access to Trigger.dev tools — search docs, trigger tasks, deploy projects, and monitor runs.
